How to get it :
- Industrial anvil (construction) : [[gv:motor|Motor]], 2 x ingot (plastic), 2 x Desh Ingot, dense wire (Gold).
- Crafting table : 4 x ingot (plastic), 2 x dense wire (Gold), 2 x Desh Ingot, [[gv:motor|Motor]].

Used to make :
[[Chemical Factory|Chemical Factory]], [[Exposure Chamber|Exposure Chamber]], [[Condenser|High-Power Steam Condenser]], [[Hydrotreater|Hydrotreater]], [[Mining Laser|Mining Laser]], [[PUREX|PUREX]], [[Pyrolysis Oven|Pyrolysis Oven]], [[Large Radar|Large Radar]], [[RBMK Autoloader|RBMK Autoloader]], [[Vacuum Refinery|Vacuum Refinery]] and 2 more.
